Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using biotinylated and FG-bead immobilized compounds to identify binding partners. While the biological study focuses heavily on SUMOylation and Ubiquitination, the actual MS assay described in the methods and PRIDE metadata is a pull-down of the compound HB007 to identify its target (CAPRIN1), not a PTM-enrichment assay (like diGly or QQTGG). Therefore, mod_ap_ms is the correct routing modifier rather than mod_ubiquitin or mod_sumo_qqtgg.
